goal.objective: On the first live canonical heartbeat, execute exactly one bounded repository worker that writes an inspectable host-runtime self-attestation receipt under the canonical heartbeat claim/fence lifecycle.
success_predicates: Exactly one eligible authorized worker is atomically claimed by the canonical heartbeat
The receipt records the live heartbeat epoch, claim, fence, worker identity and provider non-authority invariants
The worker returns COMPLETED in the same heartbeat response
The canonical runtime releases the claim and retains the receipt in durable Master Records state
failure_predicates: Worker runs without a current fenced claim
Provider liveness is treated as execution authority
Duplicate checkout or duplicate fencing is observed

task.derivation_reason: A live always-on heartbeat should prove worker activation through the heartbeat mechanism itself rather than through CI or an external scheduler.

completion.next_authorized_action: Canonical heartbeat claims the task when the dedicated host is live and the matching repository worker is AVAILABLE.
terminal_when: Receipt remains reconstructable from Master Records durable heartbeat state
